description: Compare 2–10 labeled coordinates with a shared parameter selection and window; climatology is the default resolution. Duplicate labels retain separate input-position identities. Returns per-site provenance and valid-only annual/seasonal summaries; operational site failures preserve successes. Optional numeric sort uses observation means, monthly annual records or climatology ANN, with nulls last and stable ties; differing or unknown units cannot sort. Oversized observations and summaries stage completely; summaryDatasets handles and summaryIndex preserve complete ordered summary arrays.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_window`: The requested window is reversed or outside source coverage. `invalid_correction`: Correction inputs are unsupported or missing required dependencies. `upstream_rejected`: NASA rejects the scientific request or reference lookup. `upstream_rate_limited`: NASA rate limits a request or shared reference lookup. `request_queue_full`: Source scheduling capacity is exhausted. `canvas_required`: Oversized observations or summaries require an enabled workspace. `canvas_not_found`: The supplied canvas token is absent or expired. `producer_capacity_exhausted`: Other data calls hold the in-flight capacity this call needs past its admission wait. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: Canvas count, table or retained staging capacity is exhausted. `canvas_busy`: Another query, staging or removal occupies the supplied canvas. `unsupported_preset`: The selected preset is unavailable at this resolution. `all_locations_failed`: Every requested location failed operationally. `unsupported_parameter`: Selection or sort is unsupported or requested units are incomparable. `dataset_limit`: The complete merged dataset exceeds workload bounds. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
